info.name: WORK-IN-PROGRESS: Creates a role. If your `permissions` list contains an `Admin` entry, all other entries will be discarded except `Admin`. Roles are root user-level. That means all roles created by the root user, or any subuser that has permissions to create roles, are available to all subusers.

info.name:
Gets subuser information. This call includes all of the subuser metadata. See
[https://alphauslabs.github.io/blueapi/] for the list of supported attributes.
If the `{name}` parameter is `me` or `-`, returns the caller information, which
is equivalent to `WhoAmI()` or `GET:/iam/v*/whoami`.
